_doc: Registry of opponent-property lever keys a Matchup Brief may assert (ADR-0027). A small, growing vocabulary (like Function Tags / Roles) — matchup-genie reuses a key where one fits and mints a new one only when nothing does, adding it here with consumer:'unwired' and flagging it. 'consumer' tracks whether the Read/Posture runtime maps the key onto behavior: 'unwired' = forward contract, nothing reads it yet; otherwise it names the consuming lever/gate (ADR-0038: consumption sharpens the owning Tactical signal, γ-scaled, kill-switched). validate_brief.py reads this file; unknown keys in a Brief are flagged, not silently accepted.

opp_is_engine_dependent.consumer: unwired (ADR-0051): the old brief_engine snipe/gust lever this gated was retired into the MatchupPlan spine — a Brief that wants an engine hunted now names it a `disruption_target` target directly (no property gate). Kept as a forward contract for a future engine-dependence consumer (e.g. Phase-3 proactive disruption).
opp_is_engine_dependent.note: the deck's setup hinges on a specific draw/search engine Pokémon; gusting + KOing it strangles the deck. To act on it today, tag that engine `disruption_target` in the Brief's targets.

opp_donk_vulnerable.consumer: unwired (deferred, ADR-0038): the prioritise-the-preevo-snipe half is already delivered by the fragile_preevo lever; the residual 'early aggression' half awaits a true-asserting Brief + correction evidence naming a concrete decision (ADR-0026 killed diffuse aggression priors)
opp_donk_vulnerable.note: runs low-HP single-Basic openers; an aggressive turn-1/2 line can take an early prize lead or a donk.

opp_tempo.consumer: unwired (deferred, ADR-0038): race/stabilize collides with ADR-0026's killed framings (an authored prior must not drive the Plan; diffuse aggression boosts considered-rejected) and would double-count Lever A favorability; unblock = a fast/slow-asserting Brief in the meta + correction evidence naming the decision it changes
opp_tempo.note: how fast the deck comes online and starts taking prizes; sets the race clock.

opp_is_heal_wall.note: the deck stacks effective HP + damage-reduction + healing so chip damage is undone (and may be punished, e.g. a scaling counter-attack); grinding it down is wasted. Lever (future): prefer burst/OHKO lines that clear the heal in one hit and value a weakness-type attacker; deprioritise chip. First minted for archaludon_ex_cinderace (Full Metal Lab -30 + Jumbo Ice Cream heal 80 + Raging Hammer punish). Reusable for any tank/stall archetype.

opp_accel_dependent.note: the deck's setup hinges on a specific ENERGY-ACCELERATION Pokémon (not draw/search); gusting + KOing it strangles the ramp and slows the payoff by turns. Distinct from opp_is_engine_dependent (draw/search engine). Lever (future): raise disruption value against its `engine` target when that target is an accelerator. First minted for archaludon_ex_cinderace (Cinderace — sole Metal accel, setup-only, unrecoverable).

opp_pierces_active_effects.note: the deck has a payoff attack whose damage IGNORES effects on your Active Pokémon (damage-reduction, protection, 'can't be damaged', Weakness/Resistance tricks) — so effect-based Active defenses are bypassed and only raw HP, healing, board removal, or a Weakness-type attacker answer it. Distinct from opp_is_heal_wall (which is about the OPPONENT's own bulk/heal making OUR chip worthless); this is about OUR defensive effects being void against THEIR burst. Lever (future): for any of our decks that lean on Active-effect defenses, deprioritise those tools vs this opp and prefer raw-HP / heal / removal / Weakness lines. First minted for cinderace_mega_starmie_ex (Mega Starmie ex — Nebula Beam 210 ignores Weakness/Resistance and any effects on the opponent's Active; note it is Ignition-gated burst, NOT its sustained Jetting Blow).

opp_hand_size_attacker.note: the deck's damage scales with the OPPONENT-player's own hand size (an attack with no fixed base, e.g. Alakazam Powerful Hand = 2 damage counters per card in hand), typically Active-only/single-target. Lever (future): raise the value of (a) hand-disruption / shuffle-hand-down TIMED to the swing turn (off-turn is refunded by the deck's own draw), and (b) high-HP walling the Active + promoting a fresh full-HP body after a KO to reset the damage clock; discount chip/out-grind lines. First minted for alakazam (Powerful Hand). Mirrors the `hand_size_attacker` function tag. Reusable for any hand-size-scaling attacker.

opp_single_prize.note: every attacker the deck fields is a 1-prize body (no ex / Mega-ex), so there is no multi-prize insurance and no 2-for-1 gust swing to farm — but the attacker line does not self-recur, so each KO is real progress toward six. Lever (future): value even-trade tempo and cheap recurring single-prize attackers over multi-prize burst; deprioritise gust-for-a-2-prize-swing plans that have no target here. First minted for alakazam (all-1-prize Alakazam/Dudunsparce toolbox). Reusable for any single-prize toolbox archetype.

opp_special_energy_fragile.note: the deck's ENTIRE energy base is Special energy AND it has no way to recover Special energy from the discard (e.g. its recycle only returns Pokémon or BASIC energy; its tutors only fetch from deck) — so an energy-discard-off-attacker or an energy-lock strangles its attackers with almost no path to rebuild. Distinct from opp_accel_dependent (which is about a single accelerator Pokémon). Lever (future): raise the value of special-energy discard / energy-denial lines vs this opponent; DECK-RELATIVE — inert unless our deck actually runs energy denial. First minted for hop_s_trevenant_hop_s_snorlax (4 Mist + 4 Telepath + 1 Legacy = 9/9 special, Night Stretcher recovers only Basic energy). Reusable for any all-special-energy deck lacking special-energy recursion.

opp_effect_immune_bodies.note: the deck slots energy/tools that make its key bodies immune to the EFFECTS of OUR attacks (status, can't-retreat, snipe-redirect, energy-discard-via-attack-effect) while DAMAGE, abilities, and spread all still land normally — so our effect-based disruption fizzles on those bodies but raw damage math does not. Distinct from opp_pierces_active_effects, which is the INVERSE direction (THEIR attack ignoring OUR Active-effect defences); this key is THEIR body ignoring OUR attack riders. Lever (future): deprioritise effect-rider attacks/tools vs this opponent and prefer raw-damage / weakness / ability / spread lines; route any riders at non-immune bodies. First minted for hop_s_trevenant_hop_s_snorlax (Mist Energy — prevents all attack effects on the holder; damage is not an effect). Reusable for any deck running Mist Energy or an equivalent effect-immunity attachment.

opp_ex_damage_immune.consumer: unwired (forward contract). The OVERRIDE is ALREADY resolved at concrete-attack scoring by compute_active_damage (ADR-0032, sim-verified): an attack whose AttackStat.ignoresEffects is true (the 'this attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon' clause) pierces the prevention and deals full damage, while a plain ex attack is correctly zeroed — so the Pilot never suicides a pierce attack into the wall and never over-values a plain ex swing. This property is the higher-level Read/Posture lever a future consumer must wire: recognise the wall -> for an agent whose payable attacks are plain ex (no ignoresEffects), route a NON-ex attacker into the Active / deny-the-line via the fragile_preevo snipe / race prizes; for an agent holding a pierce attack the immunity is moot. Consumer MUST AND this property with 'no ignoresEffects attack payable this turn' before treating the wall as un-attackable.
opp_ex_damage_immune.note: the deck fields walls with a prevent-all-damage-from-Pokémon-ex Ability (Crustle Mysterious Rock Inn; Sylveon PRE#330 Safeguard) — your ex / Mega-ex attackers deal ZERO (Mega-ex count as ex, rulebook L337; engine CardStat.preventsDamageFrom='ex' AND the prevent_ex_damage tag). Only a NON-ex attacker, non-attack damage (special conditions / damage-counter spread — not 'damage from an attack'), or an effect-ignoring attack (AttackStat.ignoresEffects: Nebula Beam / Spiky Hopper / Demolish / Destructive Drill / Sonic Edge / Surprise Pump / Twin Shotels / Shred) can damage them; the fragile Basics (Dwebble/Eevee) are unprotected. Distinct from opp_is_heal_wall (chip out-healed) and opp_pierces_active_effects (the OPPONENT's attack piercing OUR Active defenses — this is the reverse: OUR pierce negating THEIR defense). First minted for crustle. Reusable for any ex-immune wall (mirrors the prevent_ex_damage function tag / CardStat.preventsDamageFrom).

opp_caps_big_hits.consumer: unwired (forward contract). Like opp_ex_damage_immune, the OVERRIDE is ALREADY resolved at concrete-attack scoring by compute_active_damage (ADR-0032) via CardStat.preventsDamageAtLeast: a single hit >= threshold returns 0 UNLESS the attack has AttackStat.ignoresEffects (Nebula Beam class), which pierces the cap. Read/Posture lever a future consumer must wire: recognise the cap -> prefer sub-threshold repeatable / multi-hit damage over a single overkill nuke, OR route an ignoresEffects attack. Consumer reconciles with opp_is_heal_wall's opposite 'burst it' advice: burst is right EXCEPT a single hit at/over the cap is fully wasted.
opp_caps_big_hits.note: the deck fields a wall that prevents any single attack of N-or-more damage (Drednaw SCR44 Impervious Shell, N=200; engine CardStat.preventsDamageAtLeast=200), so a single big OHKO nuke is wasted while sub-threshold repeatable damage and effect-ignoring attacks (AttackStat.ignoresEffects) get through. Variant-only for crustle (the Drednaw line). First minted for crustle. Reusable for any burst-cap wall (mirrors CardStat.preventsDamageAtLeast).

opp_no_pivot.note: the deck runs NO gust/switch/pivot card anywhere and high retreat costs, so a Pokemon dragged/forced into the Active seat is stranded there for multiple turns (it cannot cheaply retreat or be switched, and the deck cannot reposition it). Lever (future): raise the value of OUR gust/switch/trap lines vs this opp — force an un-energized or low-value body Active and farm free setup/KO turns; a gust-and-strand outvalues a benched snipe here. Distinct from opp_is_engine_dependent (draw/search) and opp_accel_dependent (ramp) — this is about MOBILITY. First minted for kyogre_mega_abomasnow_ex (zero gust/switch in 60; retreat Snover 3 / Kyogre 3 / Mega Abomasnow ex 4). Reusable for any disruption-less high-retreat archetype.

opp_deckout_vulnerable.consumer: unwired-as-a-property, but achieved-elsewhere (2026-07-14): the core 'grind the self-mill toward a resource/deck-out loss' doctrine this key describes now ships via the CALIBRATED Resources path, not this asserted prior — the opp_resource_reads flag gates a deck-out grind nudge off board.opp_deckout_in_turns (derived from the opponent's tracked deck_count), which nudges sub-prize KO/grind lines when the opponent nears deck-out. That path is sound (measured deck-count, not an authored guess), so this property is a redundant forward contract kept only as author-side vocabulary; wiring it would double-count. A future consumer would only add value for the ASSERTED-ahead-of-evidence case (recognize the self-mill archetype before its deck-count is observably low).
opp_deckout_vulnerable.note: the deck self-mills its own library with no (or negligible) Pokemon/Trainer recovery, so a long game drifts it toward deck-out and an attacker/resource drought — its own damage engine becomes a liability over time. Lever (future): in a non-losing board state, prefer to GRIND / trade evenly and deny fast KOs rather than race, converting the opp's self-mill into a resource/deck-out loss; deprioritise plans that end the game before the mill bites. First minted for kyogre_mega_abomasnow_ex (Mega Abomasnow ex Hammer-lanche discards the top 6 every use; Kyogre recycles ONLY Basic Water Energy, so milled Pokemon/Trainers are gone for good). Reusable for any self-mill deck lacking recovery.

opp_spreads_bench.consumer: unwired (new 2026-07-09, first minted for dragapult_ex). Forward contract — needs a Board field + lever wired before it affects play. Lever (future): vs this opp, deprioritise overloading the Bench with fragile low-HP bodies and value Bench-HP / bench discipline; play around the accumulate-then-convert spread. Distinct from a single-target attacker — the threat is to the BENCH, not the Active, so Active-facing defenses do not answer it.
opp_spreads_bench.note: the deck's payoff attack places free damage counters across the opponent's BENCH every turn (never the Active) and converts the accumulated chip into multi-prize turns via a follow-up spread or a free-aim snipe; presenting a wide/fragile Bench feeds it. First minted for dragapult_ex (Phantom Dive 200 + 60 Bench spread, converted by Fezandipiti ex Cruel Arrow / the next Phantom Dive). Reusable for any bench-spread archetype.

opp_item_locks.consumer: unwired (new 2026-07-09, first minted for dragapult_ex). Forward contract — needs a Board field + lever wired before it affects play. Lever (future): vs this opp, sequence our own Item cards BEFORE the lock lands (front-load Ball/search/tool plays), lean on Supporters/Abilities on the locked turn, and don't build a line that depends on an Item on a turn the lock can hit; also flag the lock body as a cheap snipe to stop repeat locks.
opp_item_locks.note: the deck runs a repeatable one-turn Item-lock (an attack/ability that denies the opponent playing Item cards during their next turn), taxing item-heavy setup engines. First minted for dragapult_ex (Budew — Itchy Pollen, 30 HP). Reusable for any Item-lock disruptor.

opp_comeback_disruptor.consumer: consumed by Board.opp_comeback_disruptor (pilot.py) → the general `unfair-stamp-comeback-posture` hypothesis (baseline_disruption.py), which demotes emptying my hand the turn after I take a KO vs an opponent who can Unfair-Stamp. γ-gated (only fires on a recognized opponent whose Brief asserts this). Ships weight-0/ladder-gated.
opp_comeback_disruptor.note: the deck runs a post-KO hand disruptor (Unfair Stamp class): after one of THEIR Pokémon is KO'd on my last turn, they can shuffle both hands and redraw — a comeback swing. Doctrine: when I take a KO on the opponent this turn I have just ENABLED their Unfair Stamp next turn, so don't over-commit / empty my hand and value holding a re-draw out. Unfair Stamp is ACE SPEC Item id 1080 (TWM 165), verified in pool. First minted for dragapult_ex. Reusable for any deck running Unfair Stamp or an equivalent post-KO shuffle-redraw disruptor.
